item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00215","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C23","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a material template because it uses the same defense-mobilization manpower framework: an emergency manpower shortage, the need to assure manpower for essential activities, responsibilities assigned across federal agencies, and an Office of Defense Mobilization manpower policy. The child compresses and adapts that machinery to agricultural manpower while retaining universal-service constraints. C23 is relevant to the specific draft-age and universal-service setting but is a detailed regulation with little resemblance to the child's approval-letter structure. C15 shares the Office of Defense Mobilization and interagency-coordination mechanism, but addresses disaster recovery rather than manpower policy.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"pressing problems which confront us in the field of agricultural manpower","parent_excerpt":"shortages of manpower in certain special areas already being felt","explanation":"Both frame the directive around a sector-specific manpower shortage during defense mobilization."},{"child_excerpt":"insure an adequate supply of agricultural manpower","parent_excerpt":"assure the availability of manpower for all essential mobilization activities","explanation":"The child closely adapts the earlier objective of assuring adequate manpower for essential mobilization needs."},{"child_excerpt":"If the agencies of Government discharge the responsibilities which you will assign to them under Defense Manpower Policy No. 6","parent_excerpt":"I expect the head of each executive department and agency to take all necessary actions to conserve manpower","explanation":"Both implement manpower policy through assigned responsibilities across executive agencies."},{"child_excerpt":"I am in full accord with the policy and suggest you issue it promptly.","parent_excerpt":"This program ... is endorsed by the Manpower Policy Committee of the Office of Defense Mobilization, and is in line with its over-all program for conserving manpower throughout the country.","explanation":"Both expressly endorse an Office of Defense Mobilization manpower policy and authorize its implementation."}]}
